en.intro: This Opanchu Usagi Pyokotto tote bag is made of cotton and shows the character with a lovable expression, and it comes in off-white or orange. Our concierge checked the listing, and we order it from the Japanese seller Perfect World Tokyo after you place your order.
highlights: A4-size items fit easily, which makes it a good match for commuting and school.
An inner pocket makes it easy to take out a smartphone and other small items.
The size is listed as 39 x 32 x 5 cm (about 15.4 x 12.6 x 2.0 in), so you can compare it with what you usually carry.
The design shows Opanchu Usagi with a lovable expression, which suits fans who want a character bag for daily use.
Off-white and orange are offered at the same price, so you can simply pick the one you like.

sections.p: The bag measures 39 x 32 x 5 cm (about 15.4 x 12.6 x 2.0 in), as listed by the seller. A4-size items fit easily, and the inner pocket holds a smartphone or other small items.
The cotton tote shows Opanchu Usagi in the Pyokotto design, with a lovable expression. You can choose off-white or orange at the same price.

cautions: The seller lists the size only as 39 x 32 x 5 cm without saying which figure is width, height or depth; please check the product photos before ordering.
